freeze_note: config.json written BEFORE any batch09 held-out (val/test) metric was computed; immutable freeze-point for the four predeclared research fits.

population.note: Eligible = canonical S-defined AND present in the batch03 57827-gene promoter-feature universe (has frozen composition/count features and a batch05 component split). The 178 excluded genes are S-defined in the canonical expression table but absent from the promoter-feature universe.

S_label_definition.direction: larger / less-negative S = less across-tissue dispersion
S_label_definition.not: S is NOT post-transfection temporal stability
S_label_definition.reference_target: full-precision raw S (reconstructed in memory from gene_expression_table.tsv)
S_label_definition.tie_note: full-precision raw S has 0 true ties across the 18947 defined genes; the 6-decimal audit export and 10g export do not change ordering (verified). See preflight for measured tie/ordering checks.

split.name: exact/RC + detected-near-identity blocked component split (NOT homology-free)
split.note: component-level split reused exactly as frozen; retrospective not prospective; exact/RC isolation does not establish complete near-homology independence.

features.note: composition/count only; no E/S/B labels used as features.

transform_rules.X_scaler: sklearn StandardScaler (with_mean/with_std) fit on eligible TRAIN rows only; reused for val/test
transform_rules.target_standardization: z = (y - train_mean) / train_std (population std, ddof=0), fit on eligible TRAIN only
transform_rules.target_inverse: y_hat = z_hat * train_std + train_mean (back to target units)
transform_rules.rank_formula: F(x) = (count(train < x) + 0.5 * count(train == x)) / n_train; applied as a frozen function to train/val/test; values outside train support map to 0 (below) or 1 (above)
transform_rules.rank_reference_note: train-reference empirical rank; NOT the global canonical rank

evaluation.bootstrap_unit: test components (genes within a component stay together)
evaluation.bootstrap_paired: both arms evaluated on the SAME resample; delta = rank Spearman - raw Spearman
evaluation.interval: percentile interval [1.25, 98.75] percent => 97.5 percent two-sided per comparison
evaluation.interval_label: conservative two-comparison adjustment convention (two primary comparisons); each comparison uses a 97.5 percent two-sided percentile interval
evaluation.acceptance_rule: scoped target-representation improvement requires delta >= 0.03 AND adjusted lower bound > 0
primary_comparisons: rank-target minus raw-target TEST Spearman within Ridge
rank-target minus raw-target TEST Spearman within HGB
evaluation.descriptive_also: fixed Ridge vs HGB within the same conditional test rows
evaluation.no_cross_unit_mae: MAE magnitudes are NEVER compared between raw and rank units
evaluation.no_out_of_scope_comparison: do NOT compare these S results to batch06 E performance or a v6.3 result

affine_diagnostic.kind: algebra test (not a fifth research arm, not a score gain)
affine_diagnostic.metrics: paired affine R2/Spearman invariance; unit-dependent MAE (x b) / MSE (x b^2)

resources.fits: four research fits + one affine diagnostic (algebra test)
resources.no_search: no hyperparameter / architecture / threshold / target-mapping search
resources.no_validation_fit: no val/test fitting of scaler, CDF, hyperparameter, stopping rule or target mapping

scope_limits: human conditional gene-level S prediction only
not mammalian universal promoter strength / synthetic promoter activity / HEK293T construct validation / temporal stability
n=1 input equality never implies separately trained models have identical outputs
shared-trunk missing-label masking does not exclude indirect training influence from other labels
